name: Messages Improved
summary: Group MMS fixes, a faster inbox and iMessage
description: Improves the stock Messages app and its providers. Group MMS goes to the right thread, and conversations open faster. Optional iMessage through your own imsg-server: pair with a code under Settings > Advanced settings and the phone registers its number, with SMS fallback.
author: thooton

changes.text: Cache hardware isMultiSimEnabledMms and CountryDetector ISO, 1:1 zero-StringBuilder formatNames, short-circuit empty tapbacks.
Harvest in-flight Compose/Inbox root inflation Futures on cold start, raise pool priority, yield inbox row prewarm during cold chat open.
Single-IPC JPEG decodeCrispBitmap with RGB_565 thumbnails, guard drawRightStatusIndicator visibility, cache Compose XML config booleans.
Fast cached group timestamp join, skip duplicate updateBodyTextView and redundant touch listener/SIM visibility writes, TTL-cached displayName.
Skip dead mCanClusterWithPreviousMessage cursor seeks, cache showDateSent bool, guard markAsSelected, TelephonyProvider RAM temp_store and 4MB cache.
Pre-decode inline photo/video thumbnails off-main, reuse InlineVisualView in-place, cache RowHolder MMS views and typeface, zero-alloc read inbox formatMessage.
Adopt prefetched inbox cursor for zero-SQLite chat open, eager off-main media meta warmup, cached typing hint targets.
Defer cold-start background DB/Binder contention (Conversation.init, CountryDetector, mobileDataObserver, receipt policy, MMS sweep) and skip read-row SpannableStringBuilder.
Defer 4 onStart BroadcastReceiver IPCs, zero-IPC Configuration.fontScale in inbox rows, cached isAirplaneModeOn.
Cold-start root layout pre-inflation, cached Contact rounded avatar, skip duplicate onStart updateTitle and cold Contact cache wipe.
